title: Onondaga County dedicates wall honoring fallen first responders named after slain officer
summary: Onondaga County unveiled a memorial honoring first responders killed in the line of duty, naming it after Syracuse Police Officer Michael Jensen. This public recognition initiative reflects county commitment to honoring emergency services personnel and may have implications for police department morale, public safety narrative, and memorial/facilities management.
